correctness.rationale: PASS: Each predecessor block maps bijectively to a path of its output-label sequence in the four-pair De Bruijn overlap graph. Initial count at all start states is one; capping nonnegative path multiplicities at two before summation retains exactly the partition 0,1,>=2. A total capped state-sum of one is equivalent to exactly one entire finite predecessor, not just one terminal pair. Breadth-first search from (1,1,1,1) on at most 3^4=81 states is exhaustive for unbounded word lengths. Independent, separately implemented BFS for all 256 rule labels reproduced the exact length histogram, eight maximal witnesses, 92 never classes, right-boundary-only 42, and full-versus-boundary shortest gaps {0:132,1:20,2:8,3:4}. The inspected source verify.py additionally rederives and crosschecks CSV and all 32256 output words for n<=6 by direct input enumeration. Infinite absence of longer singleton words follows from finite-state closure, not merely length-six enumeration. Open-boundary definition is essential; no bilateral reversibility claim.
residual_risks: Any finite computation is corroboration only; unrestricted statement depends on the stated structural proof.
